trigger: Explicit UTC intended_start supplied by an authenticated operator; no scheduler SLA established
claim: Atomic create-only Git reference to a unique owner commit; no automatic lease expiry or takeover
recovery: Retain every claim and failed attempt; a claimed slot is never retried under another owner
outcomes: No outcome estimation in rehearsals or before a separately frozen study release
activation: Requires verified remote readback, complete provenance and prospective on-time trials on at least two UTC dates; transport-only push rehearsals do not qualify
